watch.readinessNote: The Takaro plugin hooks this build by pinned code signatures (per-build data for game build 1267041 / Steam build 25967645, Enshrouded 1.0). A build without a gamedata section falls back to built-in heuristics and capabilities that fail their self-check report degraded; a new build is blocked until the signatures are re-derived and `takaro-maint verify --game enshrouded` reports plugin-health ok (see games/enshrouded/DEVELOPMENT.md).
